{{Quote|Yow!|The furred humanoid, on multiple occasions|<ref name="Tales" />}}
A '''furred humanoid''' child was an acquaintance of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[W. Wald]], two [[Youngling/Legends|children]] who lived in the [[Galactic City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At some point between [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] and Wald spent [[Time/Legends|time]] with Skywalker, finding a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at a workplace of Skywalker's [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. Wald later dropped the lightsaber inside the new [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] of the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|racer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], leading them to return to the workplace. Watto returned to the location and ordered the humanoid and Wald out. The two later revisited and were again ordered out.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Watto|&laquo;What?! Are you two back again?!&raquo;|W. Wald|Uh-oh.|The humanoid|"Uh-oh" is right.|attr=Watto discovers W. Wald and the humanoid in the workplace for a third time|src=<ref name="Tales" />}}
[[File:AnakinandFriends-Tales14.png|thumb|left|300px|The furred humanoid was acquainted with Anakin Skywalker and W. Wald.]]
A [[Hair/Legends|furred]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] was an acquaintance of the children [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[W. Wald]],<ref name="Tales" /> both inhabitants of<ref name="CL" /><ref name="Wald">{{DB|character|wald|Wald}}</ref> the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Between [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} states that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was born in [[42 BBY/Legends|41.9 BBY]]. Skywalker is stated to be brought to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] around age three, corresponding to [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]], and not leave until [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] in [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]. Therefore, {{Tales|14|Urchins}} is set between 38 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] and 32 BBY.</ref> the humanoid spent [[Time/Legends|time]] on the world. At some point in that period, the humanoid and Wald were chased out of a workplace by [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], Skywalker's [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]]. Skywalker, watching the altercation, asked why<ref name="Tales" /> he<ref name="CL" /> had chased them, as they had not hurt anything. Watto told the [[Gender/Legends|boy]] to get back to work and left. As he did, the humanoid and Wald returned to the workplace and reentered after receiving confirmation from Skywalker that Watto was gone.<ref name="Tales" />

Wald soon found a box containing a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] inside, much to the interest of<ref name="Tales" /> his<ref name="Wald" /> companions. After the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] failed to activate the lightsaber, the children were alerted by a multi-[[Limb/Legends|tentacled]] individual that the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] had arrived with a new [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. The three exited the building and, amazed, ran off to the podracer. The three inspected an open hatch on the vehicle, which Wald shoved his way to, annoying the humanoid and dropping the lightsaber into it. As Skywalker attempted to retrieve it, Sebulba took notice. The boy was able to get the lightsaber out, but not before igniting it inside the podracer. The three then ran off as Sebulba chased after them.<ref name="Tales" />

[[File:WattoChase-Tales14.png|thumb|right|300px|Watto chased the humanoid and Wald out of the workplace.]]
Exhausted, the humanoid made it back to the workplace with his acquaintances. Skywalker stated he'd better put the lightsaber back, and that he'd have one some [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. The humanoid found the statement amusing, and soon after, Watto returned. The Toydarian angrily chased them and Wald out again. Later, after Watto and settled a debt and was in a happy mood, he discovered the humanoid and Wald back at the workplace. He chased them out once more.<ref name="Tales" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Filthy, wretched urchins&hellip; they're of no use to anyone!|Watto, on the humanoid and W. Wald|<ref name="Tales" />|translated=1}}
The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] had [[Color/Legends|ginger]] fur across their body and a black [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. They were an acquaintance of Anakin Skywalker, referred to them as "Annie," and found the prosect of him having a lightsaber amusing. Watto detested the humanoid and Wald, calling them filthy and wretched urchins and proclaiming they were both useless.<ref name="Tales" />

==Equipment==
The humanoid wore a dark [[Clothing/Legends|undershirt]], tan robes, tan pants, leg wraps and shoes.<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
The furred humanoid appeared in "[[Urchins]]," a story appearing in the [[Star Wars Tales 14|fourteenth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'',<ref name="Tales" /> published on [[December 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/11-901/Star-Wars-Tales-14-Photo-Cover|text=Star Wars Tales 14}}</ref> "Urchins" was written and drawn by [[Stan Sakai]].<ref name="Tales" />
